st.t: Talk to Curator Haig in the Varrock Museum.
Talk to the Barge Foreman north of the Dig Site.
Talk to the Sawmill Operator north east of Varrock.
s: I'm here on behalf of the museum archaeological team.

st.t: Talk to the Sawmill Operator in the Woodcutting Guild on Zeah. Without 60 Woodcutting, attempt to enter the Woodcutting Guild on Zeah to talk to the guild's sawmill operator.
s: I'm here on behalf of the museum archaeological team.

st.t: Return to the Sawmill Operator north east of Varrock.
s: I'm here on behalf of the museum archaeological team.

st.t: Return to the Barge Foreman north of the Dig Site.
Talk to the barge guard at the canal barge north of the Dig Site to board the barge.
s: Can I go onto the barge?

st.t: Talk to Jack Seagull in the Port Sarim Pub.

s: Can I go onto the barge?

st.t: Talk to the Lead Navigator again.
Talk to the Odd Old Man north of the Dig Site.
Talk to the Apothecary in south west Varrock.

s: Can I go onto the barge?

st.t: Give the Junior Navigator the bone charm.
Give the Lead Navigator the potion.

Talk to the Junior Navigator to set sail, as the Lead Navigator has passed out. When the top arrow tilts left, tap the right arrow. When it tilts right, tap the left arrow. Raise the sails to go faster, and keep going until the progress bar is full.
